title: 2026 World Webtoon Awards Opens Reader Nominations
content: Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) have opened nominations for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards, marking a shift toward reader-driven selection and the introduction of prize money for the first time.

title: 'Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, First Promo for Fall 2026
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsutomu 's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. ( Middle-Aged Man Loves Cute Things ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

title: The Biggest Isekai Anime Ever Just Set a Record No Other Isekai Anime Has Ever Achieved
content: The release of new isekai anime every season has become commonplace, but the return of the biggest isekai anime of the Spring season is setting records that no other series in the genre has ever achieved.

title: 'Got Dropped Into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work' Webtoon Breaks Record on KakaoPage Launch
content: The webtoon adaptation of Kakao Entertainment 's flagship IP Got Dropped Into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work set record-breaking performance metrics on the day of its launch on Kakao Page on June 5.

title: MAO Anime Announces 2nd Part Opening Song by Boy Group 20th Century
content: The second cours of the MAO anime will start with its 14th episode on July 4. The anime debuted on April 4 on the NHK -General channel on April 4 at 11:45 p.m. (10:45 a.m. EST) and will run for two continuous cours without breaks.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Plans to Expand to Taiwan, S. Korea
content: Entertainment news website Deadline reported on Tuesday that Crunchyroll plans to expand to Taiwan and South Korea, with localization slated to begin in Taiwan this summer, and in South Korea later in the year. Crunchyroll president Rahul Purini made the announcement during the APOS conference in Bali, Indonesia.
